say:2:1120829001:1.text: It was tough, but we've finally picked some milk thistles! Let's head back to the butler.
say:2:1120829001:1.source_cn: 好不容易，终于取得乳蓟果了！我们回去给那个执事吧。

say:3:1120829002:1.text: Oh, wait... We've gotta find some more. This isn't enough.
say:3:1120829002:1.source_cn: 啊……等下，得再多找点。就这些，不够用的。

choice_prompt:4:1120829002.text: Oh, wait... We've gotta find some more. This isn't enough.
choice_prompt:4:1120829002.source_cn: 啊……等下，得再多找点。就这些，不够用的。

say:6:1120829004:1.text: This is enough milk thistles to treat that dose of venom, but...
say:6:1120829004:1.source_cn: 中和之前那点毒，这些乳蓟果肯定是够了。不过嘛……

say:7:1120829005:1.text: With the neutralizer, Lord Pike will have a way to handle spider venom. Whether he's poisoning someone to threaten them or facing a venomous spider, he'll have what he needs.
say:7:1120829005:1.source_cn: 有了中和剂，那位荒矛老爷就有了应对蜘蛛毒液的方法。之后...

say:8:1120829006:1.source_cn: 下、下毒……还能做出这种事？

say:9:1120829007:1.text: Hey, you don't know what he's up to. A vivid imagination helps keep you alive in the desert, you know. We should have our guards up, and it's always a good idea to have a backup plan!
say:9:1120829007:1.source_cn: 谁知道呢。总之，想得越多，活得越长！留个后手，有备无患...

choice_prompt:10:1120829007.text: Hey, you don't know what he's up to. A vivid imagination helps keep you alive in the desert, you know. We should have our guards up, and it's always a good idea to have a backup plan!
choice_prompt:10:1120829007.source_cn: 谁知道呢。总之，想得越多，活得越长！留个后手，有备无患总不会错。

say:11:1120829008:1.text: I learned it from my old man! Though he's not with us anymore...
say:11:1120829008:1.source_cn: 我那个已经不在了的老爹嘛……

say:12:1120829009:1.text: He was a miner, and just like a lump of coal, he didn't say much. Just sweated his days away working in the mines.
say:12:1120829009:1.source_cn: 他是个老矿工，人也和石头一样，不爱说话，就知道下矿开凿...

say:13:1120829010:1.text: A guy like him is just too simple and honest! That kind of man couldn't last long in the Eroded Enclave.
say:13:1120829010:1.source_cn: 他啊，太淳朴太老实啦。像他那样的人在风蚀飞地这地方，活...

say:14:1120829011:1.text: Let's pick some more milk thistles so I can have some extra neutralizer on hand, just in case.
say:14:1120829011:1.source_cn: 再找点乳蓟果吧，我多准备点中和剂备着，以防万一。

say:15:1120829012:1.text: That Lord Pike, he's no ordinary man for sure...
say:15:1120829012:1.source_cn: 那位荒矛老爷，不像是普通人呐……

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 你这些道理都是从哪学来的？

choice:4:0:1.text: But we didn't give the butler much venom...
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 我们给执事的毒液并不多……
choice:4:0:1.male: But we didn't give the butler much venom...
choice:4:0:1.female: But we didn't give the butler much venom...

choice:4:1:2.text: You want more just in case?
choice:4:1:2.male: You want more just in case?
choice:4:1:2.female: You want more just in case?
